ev.q: to estimate the prevalence of ASD diagnoses among children with possible prenatal Zika virus exposure
Among 3,122 children reported to USZPIR in Puerto Rico, 109 (3.5%) had received an ASD diagnosis
the prevalence of ASD diagnosis ranged from 3.5% to 5.3%
A higher percentage of children with an ASD diagnosis were male compared with those without an ASD diagnosis.
